title: 第十九章 不讨喜的龙套死得惨第二十章 我不甚聪明只会以本伤人
content_zh:
“失败了。”
看着回来的秋临渊和李道衍，白宣直言不讳道。
李道衍闻言，面上浮现出一丝尴尬之色，有些不好意思段白语，低着头看着白宣道：“我们已成功找到血影教在凉州的分舵，将其剿灭，查抄血影教的功法秘籍，斩杀魔教贼子三百六十二人，生擒血影教凉州分舵副舵主王朝良，但凉州分舵舵主史夜行在八日前便已离开凉州分舵，言说去寻觅血影教左使血千杀，已派人追杀，但暂无收获，恐公子等得急切了，故而前来禀报。”
“八日前就走了？算算时间，也就是说，他派人来刺杀我的时候，他就已经做好了金蝉脱壳的打算。这个时候，甚至可能都离开北境了？”段白语闻言，面色微变。
若在北境，插翅难飞。
但若是离开了，天大地大，何处去寻？
“纵是离开北境，但以我镇北王府的威名，也能寻觅，秋庄主已发布江湖追杀令，定能将其擒获。”李道衍当即道。
“藏剑山庄已以藏剑山庄的名义发布江湖追杀令，发动三山五岳的江湖朋友，若是在北境，史夜行插翅难飞，而纵是出了北境，藏剑山庄在江湖上也有诸多朋友，定能捉拿，只是时日稍长，还请王妃降罪。”秋临渊亦开口，向段白语躬身认错道。
他虽并不知真相，甚至都不知道镇北王已经死了。
但镇北王世子死了，他清楚。
所以白宣就是板上钉钉的未来镇北王，而段白语是白宣的母亲，不能不敬重。
而他说的也不是假的。
藏剑山庄除了是著名的用剑山庄，同时还是出名的铸剑世家。
天下剑客无不以求得藏剑山庄名剑为荣，故而藏剑山庄在江湖上人脉极广。
听到秋临渊的话，段白语的面色稍稍好转，藏剑山庄的名声，她是知道的。
这天下的少年大多有剑客的梦，初入江湖，所想的大多都是一袭青衫，仗剑风流，一人一剑横行江湖。
哪怕经历了北荒剑魔的剑道大劫，依旧如此。
若是藏剑山庄发布追杀令，的确还有希望。
“这就是那个活捉的副舵主王朝良？”白宣则冷静地看着被秋临渊抓来的中年人道。
“是，他便是副舵主王朝良，七品入道境修为。”秋临渊解释道。

“公子饶命，一切都是史夜行那王八蛋做的，和小的没有关系，小的愿做公子奴仆，还请公子饶我一命。”
看到白宣的目光落下，王朝良吓得跪倒在地，连连磕头，全无半点高手风范。
实是心中惶恐万分，亦不知所措。
他虽是血影教凉州分舵的副舵主，但刺杀这一块的事，与他无关啊。
他虽然也不是什么好人，负责武威一代的赌场、高利贷、妓院等见不得光的活，可杀手这一块，是史夜行主管。
八日前，史夜行说去寻血影教左使，将凉州分舵的大权交给他，他还以为是多年媳妇熬成婆了。
结果，是那狗日的史夜行坑他。
“和你没关系，也就是说，你知道到底发生了什么事。说说吧，你知道多少，如果你能给我有用的信息，我可以以镇北王府的名义发誓，放了你，否则的话，我会让你感受到死也是一种享受。”白宣微笑地看着王朝良。
只是那笑容半点温度都没有，让王朝良身体一阵发寒，连忙道：“是是是，小的一定知无不言，言无不尽。”
“说吧，你们血影教接杀手任务是怎样的流程？你知道不知道是谁要你们去玉真观？而且一去就是三个七品，九个六品的江湖高手。”白宣道。
“回公子，我们血影教执行杀戮任务，是有人来付钱，然后我们动手，但这次的任务，有所不同，当初史夜行那狗贼走的时候，我多问了几句，这任务是血影教左使血千杀亲自下达的。”王朝良道。
“血千杀？你的意思是说这任务来自于血影教总坛？”白宣看着王朝良，微微皱眉。
这不太对，干娘他们牵扯的是镇北王府的继承权。
按理来说，势力范围应该在北境之内。
应该是北境的什么势力和血影教有关才是。
如今反倒是听从总坛的命令。
也就是说镇北王府的事牵扯的内容比白宣想的还有多。
“可能是，但这任务是血千杀下达的，具体是教主的意思，还是左使的意思，不得而知。”王朝良道。
“血影教的总坛在哪里？”白宣继续道。
“这……”听到总坛，王朝良脸上当即露出羞愧的神色道，“公子，血影教的总坛神秘莫测，只有舵主在被召见的时候，才有资格前去，小的只是副舵主，并没有去过总坛。”
content_en:
"Failed."
Looking at Qiu Linyuan and Li Daoyan who came back, Bai Xuan said bluntly.
Hearing this, Li Daoyan had a trace of embarrassment on his face, and Duan Baiyu was a little embarrassed. He lowered his head and looked at Bai Xuandao: "We have successfully found the branch of the Blood Shadow Sect in Liangzhou, wiped it out, searched for the blood shadow sect's secret book of exercises, and killed 362 demon sect thieves. , Wang Chao Liang, the deputy helmsman of the Liangzhou branch of the Blood Shadow Sect, was captured alive, but Shi Yexing, the helmsman of the Liangzhou branch, had left the Liangzhou branch eight days ago, saying that he was going to look for the Blood Shadow Sect’s left commander Xue Qiansha.
"You left eight days ago? Calculating the time, that is to say, when he sent people to assassinate me, he had already made plans to escape from the golden cicada. At this time, he might even have left the northern border?" Duan Baiyu's expression changed slightly when he heard this.
If you are in the north, it will be difficult to fly with wings.
But if you leave, the world is so vast, where can you find it?
"Even if he leaves the northern border, he can still be found with the reputation of my Zhenbei Prince's Mansion. Lord Qiu has issued a pursuit order, and he will definitely be captured." Li Daoyan said immediately.
"Hidden Sword Villa has issued a pursuit order in the name of Hidden Sword Villa, and mobilized friends from the rivers and lakes in three mountains and five mountains. If it were in the Northern Territory, Shi Yexing would be unable to fly, and even outside the Northern Territory, Hidden Sword Villa has many friends in the rivers and lakes, and they will definitely be able to catch him. It just takes a little longer, so please forgive the princess." Qiu Linyuan also spoke, bowing to Duan Baiyu and admitting his mistake.
Although he didn't know the truth, he didn't even know that King Zhenbei was dead.
But Prince Zhenbei was dead, and he knew it.
Therefore, Bai Xuan is the definite future King of Zhenbei, and Duan Baiyu is Bai Xuan's mother, so we cannot but respect him.
And what he said was not false.
In addition to being a famous sword-using villa, Hidden Sword Villa is also a famous sword-making family.
Swordsmen all over the world are proud to obtain the famous sword of Hidden Sword Villa, so Hidden Sword Villa has a very wide network of people in the world.
After hearing Qiu Linyuan's words, Duan Baiyu's expression improved slightly. She knew the reputation of Hidden Sword Villa.
Most young people in this world have the dream of being a swordsman. When they first enter the world, most of them think about wearing a green shirt, wielding a sword, and roaming the world with one person and one sword.
Even after experiencing the catastrophe of swordsmanship by the Northern Wilderness Sword Demon, this is still the case.
If Hidden Sword Villa issues a pursuit order, there is indeed hope.
"Is this the deputy helmsman Wang Chaoliang who was captured alive?" Bai Xuanze calmly looked at the middle-aged man captured by Qiu Linyuan and asked.
"Yes, he is the deputy helmsman Wang Chaoliang, who is in the seventh-level Taoist realm." Qiu Linyuan explained.
"Young master, please spare my life. Everything was done by that bastard Shi Yexing and has nothing to do with me. I am willing to be your slave, so please spare my life."
Seeing Bai Xuan's eyes fall, Wang Chaoliang was so frightened that he knelt down and kowtowed repeatedly, showing no trace of the master's demeanor.
I was really terrified and at a loss what to do.
Although he is the deputy helmsman of the Liangzhou branch of the Blood Shadow Sect, the assassination has nothing to do with him.
Although he is not a good person and is responsible for the casinos, loan sharks, brothels and other shady activities of the Wuwei generation, Shi Yehang is in charge of the killer department.
Eight days ago, Shi Yexing said that he was going to find the left envoy of the Xueying Cult and hand over the power of Liangzhou Branch to him. He thought that his daughter-in-law of many years had become a mother-in-law.
In the end, it was that stupid Shi Yexing who tricked him.
"It has nothing to do with you, that is to say, you know what happened. Tell me how much you know. If you can give me useful information, I can swear in the name of Zhenbei Palace to let you go. Otherwise, I will make you feel that death is also a kind of enjoyment." Bai Xuan looked at Wang Chaoliang with a smile.
But the smile didn't have any warmth at all, which made Wang Chaoliang's body shiver, and he said quickly: "Yes, yes, the young one must tell everything he knows."
"Tell me, what is the process for your Blood Shadow Cult to take on assassin missions? Do you knowI don’t know who asked you to go to Yuzhen Temple? And there were three seventh-grade and nine sixth-grade martial arts masters there. "Bai Xuan said.
"Back to the young master, our Blood Shadow Sect performs killing missions. Someone pays for it, and then we do it. But this mission is different. When that thief Shi Yexing left, I asked a few more questions. This mission was personally issued by the Blood Shadow Sect's left commander Xue Qiansha. "The good way of the dynasty.
"Thousands of blood kills? You mean this mission comes from the Blood Shadow Cult General Forum? "Bai Xuan looked at Wang Chaoliang and frowned slightly.
This is not right. Godmother and the others are involved in the inheritance of Zhenbei Palace.
Logically speaking, the sphere of influence should be within the northern border.
It should be some force in the north that is related to the Blood Shadow Cult.
Now, he is following the orders of the main altar.
In other words, the matter at Zhenbei Palace involves more than Bai Xuan thought.
"Maybe, but this mission was issued by Xue Qiansha. Whether it was the leader's intention or the Zuo envoy's intention is unknown. "The good way of the dynasty.
"Where is the headquarters of the Blood Shadow Sect? "Bai Xuan continued.
"This..." Upon hearing the main altar, Wang Chaoliang said with a look of shame on his face, "Sir, the main altar of the Blood Shadow Sect is mysterious and unpredictable. Only the helmsman is qualified to go when he is summoned. The younger one is only the deputy helmsman and has never been to the main altar. "
